scope: Offline attribution of the unchanged fixed benchmark reference price. No new RPC call, network validation, fee measurement or proof was performed.

node_getCurrentMinFees.timestampMeaning: Filesystem modification metadata only; not a timestamp embedded in the RPC response.

node_getBlockNumber.timestampMeaning: Filesystem modification metadata only; not a timestamp embedded in the RPC response.

node_getNodeInfo.timestampMeaning: Filesystem modification metadata only; not a timestamp embedded in the RPC response.
node_getNodeInfo.retention: Selected identity fields only; source SHA256 covers the entire original response.

contemporaneousBlockNumberSample.relationship: Separate saved RPC response, with a filesystem modification time within one second of the min-fee and node-info files. It is not a block anchor for the price quote.

laterLiveReceiptSample.explanation: A later live fee quote accompanying three older finalized receipt samples. Neither that quote nor the sampled blocks supplies the fixed reference value.
laterLiveReceiptSample.gasInterpretation: Live receipt gas is inferred under the saved zero-priority-fee assumption; exact division is an arithmetic check, not a separately captured gas-meter result.

attributionLimits: The fee RPC response itself contains no timestamp, block identifier or network identity.
Capture timing relies on explicitly labeled filesystem metadata. Adjacent node-info and block-number responses provide associated context, not a cryptographic same-block assertion.
The price is historical and held fixed for controlled billed-gas comparisons; it is not a current fee quote, future fee forecast, or the actual fee price of each local receipt.
No RPC URL, credential or node ENR is retained in these added artifacts.
recommendedDescription: A fixed benchmark reference price matching the saved live node_getCurrentMinFees response; associated filesystem save metadata is approximately 2026-09-10 20:52:52 UTC. The separately sampled block number was 79426, without proof that this was that block’s fee price.
